Meeting summary
- Attendees: Jordan Ellis (Acme), Lisa Chen (Acme - Eng), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Neha Kapoor (Redwood - CS), Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood - SE)
- Current status: Acme is approaching renewal for core Redwood APIs (current commit: 3 vCPU reserved equivalent usage; Q3 renewal in Aug).
- Current pain points:
  - Token spend unpredictability on batch inference workloads (peak spikes during nightly ranking runs)
  - Latency for the new search reranking pipeline (p95 up to 850ms on current model + infra)
  - Lack of observability into per-route cost breakdowns for engineering/product teams
- Goals discussed:
  - Stabilize p95 latency <= 300ms for reranking workload
  - Reduce per-token unit cost for batch workloads by ~20% via batching + quantization recommendations
  - Add a dedicated slot for the new summarization workload (expected 50QPS peak)

Recommended expansion path (what we propose)
1) Dedicated capacity add-on: add one 8-GPU pod (reserved) to cover reranking + summarization with predictable throughput and SLA. This will address latency and isolation concerns.
2) Optimize configuration: SE-led benchmark to tune batching/KV cache + apply quantization profile for the batch jobs (targeting ~20% cost reduction). Vivek to run benchmarks and share results.
3) Observability + billing: enable the Console cost-per-route dashboard and a 30-day retention for debugging (trial for next 60 days).
4) Commercial: proposed term is a 12-month renewal with the dedicated add-on. We showed a preliminary pricing outline in the call; I attached the updated pricing PDF and your usage export for Q1–Q2.

Attachments: acme_usage_q1_q2.csv; proposed_pricing_v2.pdf

Open questions / asks for Acme
- Confirm the target go-live window for the reranking SLA and summarization workload (we suggested a mid-Sept rollout).
- Confirm if procurement should be looped now or after Vivek shares the benchmark numbers.

Next steps / owners
- Vivek: run workload benchmarks (ETA 6 business days) and share numbers + recommended config.
- Neha: prepare onboarding checklist for dedicated pod and proposed runbook (ETA 5 business days).
- Marissa (me): update proposal and send to procurement with the formal SOW and pricing by EOD Monday 6/22.

If that all looks right, Jordan, I’ll schedule the SE benchmark kickoff with your team for Tuesday 6/23.
